reasoning: On the season so far the Raptors are the stronger team; with home court the Raptors start about 9 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Wizards.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Raptors win 70 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.

analyst.text: Toronto lost a fifth straight on Tuesday, their 15th in a row against New York, with Kawhi Leonard sitting for knee management, and now play the second night of a back-to-back. Washington have lost eight straight, Brian Keefe cut short his press conference after the 28-point loss in Houston, and his seat is being described as warm. Two frustrated teams; the angle leans mildly towards Toronto at home.
